About.Name: WIN ICO
About.Author: RainbowHype
About.Comment: An extension that changes the application's header and taskbar icon (NOT the EXE file's icon). Made for RayTheRee.

ActionMenu: Set Header and Taskbar icons from small ICO
Set Taskbar icon from large ICO

Actions.Title: Set Header and Taskbar icons (small): %0
Parameters: Path to .ico file (16x16 or higher quality recommended)

Actions.Title: Set Taskbar icon (large): %0
Parameters: Path to .ico file (32x32 or higher quality recommended)

Properties.Title: Auto-Reset icons on object destruction
Properties.Info: If enabled, the 'reset icons' action is automatically called upon destroying the object (or switching frames, since that destroys all objects).
